headline: X-Men #94 Hits The Auction Block
post:

Now, a CGC NM 9.4 copy of this legendary issue is up for auction at Heritage with a starting bid of $2,600. ⚡

Would you add this historic comic to your collection?

headline: Ranking Cillian Murphy in Christopher Nolan movies
post:
Did you know Cillian Murphy has appeared in six films directed by Christopher Nolan? According to /Film, their incredible partnership began when Murphy auditioned for Bruce Wayne in "Batman Begins." While he didn't land the lead role then, Nolan fought to cast him as the chilling villain Doctor Jonathan Crane, the Scarecrow. 🎬

From playing the traumatized Shivering Soldier in "Dunkirk" to his emotional turn as Robert Fischer in "Inception," Murphy has consistently delivered unforgettable supporting work. Of course, this creative journey ultimately led to him carrying "Oppenheimer" on his back and winning a well-deserved Best Actor Oscar.

Which of these six fantastic performances is your absolute favorite? 

#CillianMurphy #ChristopherNolan #Oppenheimer
original_title: All 4 Cillian Murphy Performances In Christopher Nolan Movies, Ranked

headline: Kylo Ren's Final Comic Chapter Arrives Soon
post:
Get ready to say goodbye to Ben Solo all over again. According to Screen Rant, the closing chapter of "The Fall of Kylo Ren" is set to drop on December 2, 2026, from Marvel Comics. This final issue follows the character's time as Supreme Leader ofysts the First Order and events leading directly into "The Rise of Skywalker". 

Authors Benjamin Percy and Charles Soule have worked to flesh out parts of the character's arc that the Sequel Trilogy glossed over. The series, along with "The Legacy of Vader", operates with the goal to help fans gain a better understanding of the journey. Because Disney has given the character no future, this is chronologically the last moment in the timeline the comics can engage with him in. 

Will you be picking up this final issue? 🌌

#KyloRen #StarWars #MarvelComics
original_title: Kylo Ren's Final Star Wars Story Is Only 1 Month Away
